newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Commission prepares for ECSC treaty expiry.
newsitem.headline: Commission prepares for ECSC treaty expiry.

text.p: The European Commission will hold a first discussion on Wednesday on preparations for the expiry of the European Coal and Steel Community (ECSC) treaty.
"This will be a general debate, a first discussion on how to prepare for that," a Commission official said on Tuesday, adding that there would not be any concrete results at this early stage.
The treaty, which came into being on August 10, 1952, expires in the year 2002.

It gives the Commission much stronger influence over the EU's coal and steel industries than it has over other industries. The ECSC also has its own budget, financed by levies on steel and coal firms. However, these are currently being phased out.

The official said it was an open question whether elements of the ECSC treaty would need to be transferred to the EU's Treaty of Rome. The intergovernmental-conference could in that case be a good opportunity to do so, he said.
